mapper.update: create table if not exists exchange_table ( name varchar(50) primary key, type int not null, durable boolean not null, auto_delete boolean not null, arguments varchar(1024) )
create table if not exists queue_table ( name varchar(50) primary key, durable boolean not null, exclusive boolean not null, auto_delete boolean not null, arguments varchar(1024) )

create table if not exists binding_table ( exchange_name varchar(50) not null, queue_name varchar(50) not null, binding_key varchar(256) not null, primary key (exchange_name, queue_name, binding_key) )
mapper.insert: insert into exchange_table ( name, type, durable, auto_delete, arguments ) values ( #{name}, #{type.type}, #{durable}, #{autoDelete}, #{arguments} )
insert into queue_table ( name, durable, exclusive, auto_delete, arguments ) values ( #{name}, #{durable}, #{exclusive}, #{autoDelete}, #{arguments} )
mapper.select: select name, case type when 0 then 'DIRECT' when 1 then 'FANOUT' when 2 then 'TOPIC' end as type, durable, auto_delete as autoDelete, arguments from exchange_table
select name, durable, exclusive, auto_delete as autoDelete, arguments from queue_table
select exchange_name as exchangeName, queue_name as queueName, binding_key as bindingKey from binding_table
